summary: Fury Gold Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 13, 2026, attaching a press release reporting drill results from its Eau Claire gold project in Quebec. The release announced intercepts of 7.01 g/t gold over 21.0 meters and mobilization of a third drill rig for an ongoing Phase 2 program. There is no change of control, no offer, no shareholder vote, no financial advisor engagement, and no structural transformation. The filing is a routine operational update and does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories.
